data.name: It's Just a Rescue, Bro! — Idle Hell RPG
data.detailed_description:
I just wanted to bring my bro home for some grilled fish and gains. Somehow I punched through the entire Hell Dynasty.

Your musclebound best friend Tiezhu has been kidnapped by the Princess of Hell herself. You — a frontier villager whose only life goal was napping — grab a sword and set off to get him back. Idle grinding × loot hunting × a comedy that keeps twisting: it grows stronger while you're away, and you grow stronger when you take the wheel.

[Fully Automatic Combat — Take Over Anytime]
Auto-targeting, auto-skills: progress happens while you idle. Switch to manual mode to dodge and outplay the bosses that auto-battle can't crack. Chant devastating mage AoEs or carve through packs in melee — two class trees with 16 ultimate specializations to respec into, anytime.

[Fighting Is a Side Job — Living Is the Game]
Woodcutting, mining, fishing, farming, cooking, smithing, alchemy — seven life skills, all idle-friendly, all feeding your power: food buffs, combat potions, smelted ingots for upgrades. Build your anti-Hell hometown, one building at a time.

[Loot, Then Loot Some More]
Five rarity tiers, random affixes, enhancing, socketing, gems and enchants — every single monster might drop the item that rewrites your build.

[Rebirth, Come Back Stronger]
Rebirth at any moment: keep your gear, life skills and town, reroll your class, and earn Nirvana Stones to light up permanent talents — pushing the level cap from 240 all the way to 300.

[The Sky Tower: Climb Without End]
Max level is not the finish line. Enter the infinitely tall Sky Tower, where every floor hits harder — take the build of a lifetime as high as it goes and race the world on the global leaderboard. (Leaderboard requires an online account; offline climbing is unrestricted.)

[A 20-Chapter Comedy of Betrayed Expectations]
The kidnapped bro is… thriving in Hell? The "villain" princess has her reasons? Snark your way through 20 chapters and pick the ending yourself.

data.short_description: I just wanted to rescue my bro from the Princess of Hell — now I'm conquering the whole Hell Dynasty. An idle loot RPG: auto-battle, 16 ultimate classes, 7 idle life skills, endless gear hunting, rebirth talents, a 20-chapter comedy, and an infinite tower with global leaderboards.
data.supported_languages: English, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz (Intel i3 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU with hardware acceleration (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Cloud saves and leaderboards require an internet connection.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU with hardware acceleration (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Cloud saves and leaderboards require an internet connection.
